collateralizationRatio.rationale: The wrapper originates no borrower debt and runs no collateralized vault system of its own; a system collateralization ratio is structurally undefined at the wrapper level.

liquidationCapacityRatio.rationale: The wrapper has no debt of its own to offset; its deposits are themselves liquidation capital committed to the parent BOLD system.
